decision: Adopt APOS v0.2 with maturity-based architecture, selective context compilation and governed provider-neutral AI execution.
rationale: This controls the permanent cost of architecture and agent context while preserving a simple human-assisted operating mode until repeatable work and eval evidence justify API automation.
alternatives: Build a custom multi-agent platform immediately
Bind APOS to one model provider
authority_source: Explicit builder request on 2026-09-07 to create APOS v0.2 and its memorial
scope: Candidate branches and local files only; no main publication, release, provider account or paid API use
